experiments.analysis: Hypothesis falsified. The scalar-load staging itself is not the binding constraint: the fused two-loop form already lets ptxas batch loads, while the three-phase split appears to delay Phase C vector-load issue behind Phase B's L chain and adds an exp2 recompute on each accumulate iteration's critical path. The damage concentrates exactly in the mid-rows_bound 2C class the mechanism targeted (grid ~2x SMs, rpc 2, small S), so the latency-bound profile diagnosis (SOL 20.88%, 11.56 warp-cycles/instr) was correct but the restructure is the wrong remedy - the merge's gap is not recoverable by register-staging the merge weights. Bitwise parity 13/13 confirms the measurement is pure device speed, not semantics. Restored C5a per the pre-registered D2 fallback; a cheaper variant (Phase A staging only, fused L+acc loop kept) was considered and NOT pursued: it is not pre-registered, needs 2 more dev jobs, and EV is doubtful after this falsification. Recorded as an open lever for future attempts.
